rules.description: Variants object must be exported (export const fadeVariants = {...}) for consumption by components
Every animated variant set must have a reduced-motion fallback via useReducedMotion() or CSS media query
Animate only GPU-composited properties: x/y/scale/rotate/opacity. Never width/height/top/left
Use Framer Motion animate prop or CSS classes — avoid inline style={{transition:...}}
Animation duration must be between 50ms and 2000ms
Easing must be a named preset (easeOut, spring...) or valid cubic-bezier()
If enter/visible variant is defined, an exit variant should also be defined for AnimatePresence
